title: Save a new link with tags and a reminder
description: This verifies that a user can create a new link item, add tags and an optional deadline, save it, and see it appear in the vault.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type a link URL into the quick action input
Add category tags
Set an optional reminder or deadline
Save the item to the personal vault
Verify the new item appears in the feed
Verify the item shows the saved tags or deadline

title: Save a new note with tags
description: This verifies that a user can create a free-form note, tag it, save it, and find it in the vault.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Type note content into the quick action input
Add category tags
Save the item to the personal vault
Verify the new note appears in the feed
Verify the saved tags are shown for the note

title: Delete an item after confirming the prompt
description: This verifies that a user can delete a saved item from the viewer and see it removed from the vault after confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an item card in the feed
Delete the item
Confirm the deletion
Verify the item is removed from the vault
Verify the deleted item no longer appears in the feed

title: Open an item and edit its details
description: This verifies that a user can open a saved item, update its content or tags, save the changes, and see the updated item in the vault.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an item card in the feed
Edit the item title, notes, or tags
Save the changes
Verify the updated item is shown in the viewer or feed
Verify the edited content or tags are reflected

title: Snooze or archive an item from the viewer
description: This verifies that a user can change an item’s status from the detailed viewer and see the vault update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an item card in the feed
Snooze the reminder or archive the item
Verify the item status is updated
Verify the item is reflected in the vault after the change

title: Find a saved item by search
description: This verifies that searching the vault narrows the feed to matching items and preserves access to the matching content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Enter a search query in the search bar
Verify the feed is narrowed to matching items
Verify the matching item remains accessible in the feed

title: Open the calendar view from the main app
description: This test verifies that a user can open the calendar view from the dashboard and see saved deadlines in a calendar layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the calendar view
Verify the calendar view is displayed
Verify saved deadlines are displayed on the calendar

title: Filter the feed by tag
description: This verifies that selecting a tag chip filters the feed to items in that category.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a tag chip in the feed
Verify the feed is filtered to the selected tag
Verify only matching items are shown

title: View items due on a selected calendar date
description: This test verifies that selecting a date in the calendar shows the items due on that day.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the calendar view
Select a date in the calendar
Verify items due on the selected date are displayed
Verify the selected date remains highlighted or active

title: Switch between month and week calendar views
description: This test verifies that a user can switch calendar layouts and see the calendar update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the calendar view
Switch to week view
Verify the week calendar layout is displayed
Switch back to month view
Verify the month calendar layout is displayed

title: Move the calendar to a different month
description: This test verifies that changing calendar months updates the visible calendar to the selected month.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the calendar view
Move to a different month
Verify the calendar updates to the selected month
Verify calendar items for that month are displayed

title: Copy an item link from the viewer
description: This verifies that a user can copy a saved item link from the item viewer and see a copy confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an item card in the feed
Copy the item link
Verify a copy confirmation is visible
Verify the item remains open in the viewer

title: Open a shared item from a public link
description: This test verifies that a public recipient can open a valid shared link and see the shared item details and link card.

steps.description: Navigate to /share/:token
Verify the shared item title is displayed
Verify the shared item description and link card are displayed

title: Switch between feed layouts
description: This verifies that a user can switch the vault between grid and list layouts and the feed updates accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Switch the feed to a different layout
Verify the feed layout changes
Verify saved items are still visible after the layout change

title: Switch the app theme
description: This verifies that a user can open settings and switch between dark and light themes, with the app appearance updating accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open Settings view
Toggle the app theme
Verify the app appearance updates to the selected theme

title: Review weekly digest insights
description: This test verifies that a user can open the weekly digest, review saved content statistics and breakdowns, and close it to return to the vault.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Weekly Digest modal
Verify weekly saved content statistics are displayed
Verify top tags and domain breakdowns are displayed
Close the modal
Verify the main vault view is displayed

title: Change the device nickname
description: This verifies that a user can edit the device nickname in settings and save the updated name successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open Settings view
Edit the device nickname
Save the device nickname change
Verify the updated device nickname is shown

title: Open a shared item and copy its share link
description: This verifies that a public recipient can copy the shared link from the shared viewer and receive confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /share/:token
Copy the shared link
Verify a copy confirmation is visible
Verify the shared item remains visible

title: Review weekly digest without losing vault context
description: This test verifies that opening and closing the weekly digest preserves access to the vault so the user can continue organizing items afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Weekly Digest modal
Close the modal
Verify the main dashboard is displayed
Verify saved items remain accessible in the vault

title: Copy the shared link from the public viewer
description: This test verifies that a public recipient can copy the shared item link successfully from the shared viewer.

steps.description: Navigate to /share/:token
Copy the shared link
Verify a copy confirmation is visible
Verify the shared link remains available in the viewer

title: View sync status in settings
description: This verifies that a user can open settings and view the current sync status without leaving the settings area.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open Settings view
Verify the sync status is displayed

title: Handle a missing shared item link
description: This test verifies that an invalid or missing shared share route shows a missing-item state instead of a shared viewer.

steps.description: Navigate to /share/:token
Verify a missing item state is displayed
Verify the shared item viewer is not displayed

title: View keyboard shortcuts in settings
description: This verifies that a user can open settings and view the available keyboard shortcuts for the app.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open Settings view
Verify the keyboard shortcuts are displayed
